UIPageClass.py.summary: This page class represents the Settings screen of the application, providing access to user settings and feedback options. It contains locators for key interactive elements such as the settings button and feedback button, and includes methods to verify the visibility and state of screen components based on user authentication status.

methods.description: Verifies that all essential elements on the settings screen are visible and properly displayed to the user, with verification logic that adapts based on the user's authentication state.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: A boolean flag indicating whether the user is currently authenticated and logged into the application. This parameter determines which settings elements should be visible, as logged-in users may have access to additional settings options.

methods.method_purpose: This method functionally validates the presence and visibility of critical UI elements on the settings screen, performing conditional checks based on the user's login status to ensure that the appropriate settings interface is displayed correctly.
